subject: Proposal: split technical + procurement review — need new demo windows
messages:
From: Evan Miles <evan.miles@acmecorp.com>
To: jonas_weber <jonas@redwood.com>
Cc: Priya Rao <priya.ra o@acmecorp.com>, security@acmecorp.com
Date: 2027-08-29T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Redwood demo — added security/platform/procurement

Hi Jonas,

Thanks for yesterday's session — the execs were happy with the product direction. A couple of follow-ups from our side: our security and platform teams want a deeper walkthrough (networking, KV-cache behavior, isolation modes) and procurement wants a separate commercial run-through to align on licensing/commitment options. That means we need more folks in the loop and likely a different cadence.

Two constraints: several of our leads are traveling next week (internal offsites) and we have a procurement blackout the week after. Can we propose either a split-day format (technical AM, procurement PM) on Sept 7 or two shorter sessions on Sept 9 and 10?

Attached are the initial security questions (acme-security-questions.xlsx) so you can prep.

—Evan
Evan Miles
Senior Manager, Cloud Platform | Acme Corp
From: jonas_weber <jonas@redwood.com>
To: Evan Miles <evan.miles@acmecorp.com>
Cc: marissa_cole <marissa@redwood.com>, vivek_kulkarni <vivek@redwood.com>, kimberly_park <kimberly@redwood.com>, Priya Rao <priya.ra o@acmecorp.com>
Date: 2027-08-29T10:08:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Redwood demo — added security/platform/procurement

Evan — thanks for the quick note and the attachment. We can absolutely accommodate a split approach. Two thoughts:

• Split-day (Sept 7): AM technical deep-dive (90 mins) with platform + security; PM procurement/commercial (60 mins) with sales + finance. This keeps continuity for your team if people can carve half days.
• Two short sessions (Sept 9 & 10): 60 mins each, focused agendas — option if travel prevents a single-day commitment.

I've looped in Vivek (security lead) to confirm what we can cover in 90 minutes and Kim (solutions) to tailor the procurement materials. Marissa will own the commercial discussion and contract options.

Would you prefer we hold tentative calendar slots and finalize once you confirm who can attend? I can send a proposed agenda (adapted from our demo) and a calendar invite with both options.

Thanks — Jonas
Jonas Weber
Enterprise Sales, Redwood Inference
jonas@redwood.com | +1 415-555-0128
From: vivek_kulkarni <vivek@redwood.com>
To: jonas_weber <jonas@redwood.com>, marissa_cole <marissa@redwood.com>, kimberly_park <kimberly@redwood.com>
Cc: Evan Miles <evan.miles@acmecorp.com>, Priya Rao <priya.ra o@acmecorp.com>
Date: 2027-08-29T13:22:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Redwood demo — added security/platform/procurement

Jonas / team — quick note from the security side on what we should include in the technical slot if we go split-day:

1) Network isolation & VPC deployment model (15 mins) — diagrams + traffic flow.
2) KV cache and multi-tenant memory behavior under bursts (20 mins) — we can demo cache hit scenarios.
3) Key management integrations (KMS/HSM options) and audit log sample (15 mins).
4) Compatibility & fallback policy (10 mins) — how we route to variants during capacity constraints.

We should limit the live model demo to specific sequences (not full longform) so we don't hit token/timeouts. If the customer can send a short prompt set (2–3 examples) we can run them ahead and surface latencies.

I can present 60% and hand over to Kim for infra ops questions. If scheduling looks tight, favor the two-session approach so we don't rush.

—Vivek
Vivek Kulkarni
Sr. Product Security Engineer, Redwood Inference
From: marissa_cole <marissa@redwood.com>
To: jonas_weber <jonas@redwood.com>, vivek_kulkarni <vivek@redwood.com>, kimberly_park <kimberly@redwood.com>
Cc: Evan Miles <evan.miles@acmecorp.com>, Priya Rao <priya.ra o@acmecorp.com>
Date: 2027-08-30T08:45:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Redwood demo — added security/platform/procurement

Looping procurement: Evan, if the procurement team wants to get into commitment tiers, we should allocate 45–60 mins and bring pricing scenarios + SLO/uptime language. I can prepare three options:

A) Pilot — 3 months, burst capacity, month-to-month
B) Committed Dedicated — 12 months, reserved GPU pool, discount tier
C) Enterprise Private — VPC/on-prem discussion (longer lead time)

I’ll attach a one-pager and proposed contract slide for the meeting. For calendar planning: I’m +1 on Sept 9 & 10 (two 60-min sessions) — reduces friction for travel and gives us room to follow up.

Attachments: Redwood-demo-agenda-v3.pdf (agenda + roles)

Thanks — Marissa
Marissa Cole
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
From: jonas_weber <jonas@redwood.com>
To: Evan Miles <evan.miles@acmecorp.com>, Priya Rao <priya.ra o@acmecorp.com>, marissa_cole <marissa@redwood.com>, vivek_kulkarni <vivek@redwood.com>, kimberly_park <kimberly@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-08-31T16:05:00-07:00
Subject: Confirmed: Sept 9 (technical) & Sept 10 (procurement) — calendar invites sent

Evan / Priya — thanks for working through options. Based on travel and procurement blackout, we’ve tentatively scheduled: 

• Sept 9, 10:00–11:00 PDT — Technical deep-dive (Vivek + Kim presenting).
• Sept 10, 14:00–15:00 PDT — Procurement & commercial (Marissa + Jonas).

I created tentative calendar events (please accept) and attached a final agenda for both sessions (Redwood-demo-agenda-v3.pdf). Evan — if you can confirm the specific security leads who will attend, Vivek will run a quick pre-read on Sept 8 (30 mins) to align on the prompt set and expectations.

Action items: 
- Evan: confirm attendees for security/platform by EOD Sept 2.
- Priya: list any must-have procurement clauses you want discussed (SLA, data retention).
- Redwood: circulate pre-read and ask for sample prompts.

Looking forward to it — Jonas
Jonas Weber
Enterprise Sales, Redwood Inference
